info.title: PN Shop Store API
info.description:
Catalog, content, cart, checkout and customer accounts for headless storefronts and apps.

* **Authentication:** optional. Customers sign in with `POST /auth/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
* **Guest carts:** send the cart `token` from cart responses as the `X-Cart-Token` header.
* **Language:** set with `?locale=` or `Accept-Language`.
* **Errors:** `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
* **Retries:** send `Idempotency-Key` when placing orders.

post.description:
Turns the cart into an order and starts the payment. Send an Idempotency-Key header so
a retried request cannot place the order twice. When `payment.outcome` is `redirect`,
send the customer to `payment.redirect_url`. Guests read the order later through
`links.order` (a signed URL); customers through /account/orders.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key (e.g. a UUID) that makes retries safe: a repeat within 24 hours returns the first response.

category includes its subcategories), `filter[<attribute id>][]=<value id>` and `q`
